statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33186 (GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3, GO-2026-4762): before 1.79.3, the google.golang.org/grpc server routes requests whose HTTP/2 :path lacks the leading slash, while authorization interceptors such as grpc/authz evaluate the raw path, so deny rules written for the canonical path can be bypassed. It is fixed in 1.79.3: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/security/advisories/GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4762. We read the Go build information and the Go function table (pclntab) of every Go program in every published build-fips package in the authenticated DHI Alpine 3.23 security repository, where the FIPS packages are published, x86_64 and aarch64: 91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only, each package verified against the index checksum. 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times per architecture with different checksums; the copy the repository serves was the one read. The Go programs are /usr/bin/build, from 2.26.2-r1 also /opt/docker/dhi/yq, and from 2.28.0-r1 also /usr/bin/dhi-source; from 2.27.1-r1 the packages also carry /opt/docker/dhi/uv, which is not a Go program. The function table of /usr/bin/build and, where present, /usr/bin/dhi-source lists all three of the advisory's grpc functions, (*Server).Serve, (*Server).ServeHTTP and (*Server).handleStream, in every build; /opt/docker/dhi/yq does not contain the grpc module. The 15 builds before 2.9.0-r0 contain google.golang.org/grpc 1.76.0, inside the affected range; 2.9.0-r0 and every later build contain 1.79.3 to 1.83.2, which carry the fix, so 2.9.0-r0 is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-33186 (GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3, GO-2026-4762): a gRPC-Go server accepted a :path without a leading slash, which could bypass path-based authorization. google.golang.org/grpc before 1.79.3 is affected: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/security/advisories/GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3. The metrics-server-fips packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from the same metrics-server source as metrics-server, with Go's FIPS 140-3 mode enabled, but they are published in a separate DHI repository that this review could not read, so no metrics-server-fips build has been inspected for this advisory. Pending: reading the google.golang.org/grpc version recorded in every published metrics-server-fips build for Alpine 3.23 (x86_64 and aarch64) to place each build against the fix, as was done for the metrics-server packages.

CVE-2026-33186 (GO-2026-4762, GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3): a gRPC-Go server accepted requests whose :path lacked the leading slash, which could bypass path-based authorization interceptors. google.golang.org/grpc before 1.79.3 is affected: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/security/advisories/GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4762 . Read the Go build information of /usr/bin/metrics-server in every published metrics-server package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-27 (29 builds, 0.8.1-r0 to the current 0.9.1-r2, each for x86_64 and aarch64, 58 packages, each download checked against the size and control checksum in the package index). Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/metrics-server, a statically linked Go program (no ELF interpreter, no dynamic section) built with CGO_ENABLED=0; both architectures record the same build information in every build. It records google.golang.org/grpc v1.72.0 in 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r3, v1.79.3 in 0.8.1-r4 to 0.8.1-r12, v1.81.1 in 0.9.0-r0, v1.82.1 in 0.9.0-r1 to 0.9.0-r4, v1.83.1 in 0.9.0-r5 to 0.9.0-r6, v1.83.2 in 0.9.0-r7, v1.85.0-dev.0.20260825072537-93e31b48545e in 0.9.0-r8, v1.86.0-dev in 0.9.0-r9 to 0.9.0-r11, v1.85.0 in 0.9.0-r12 to 0.9.1-r2; the server code the advisory names, (*Server).handleStream, is linked in every build. 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r3 use grpc v1.72.0, inside the affected range; 0.8.1-r4 and every later build use v1.79.3 or later (including development versions of 1.85.0 and 1.86.0), which carry the fix.
